newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan buys 6,000 T palm oil, 3,000 T palm olein.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan buys 6,000 T palm oil, 3,000 T palm olein.

text.p: The state-run Trading Corporation of Pakistan (TCP) on Tuesday bought 6,000 tonnes of RBD palm oil and 3,000 tonnes of palm olein for October 10 delivery, dealers in Karachi said.
The TCP bought the palm oil from low bidder Pan Century at $559.40 per tonne C&F Karachi and the olein from Felda at $595 per tonne C&F Karachi, the traders said.
The TCP made the purchases on behalf of the state-run Ghee Corporation of Pakistan, which has vegetable oil processing units, one trader said.
